prior_evidence.rationale: Use the largest already-qualified baseline-admissible top-flux magnitude rather than extending the failed RZM06A4 grid post hoc.

candidate_space.enumeration: outer pulse_count in listed order, middle relax_count in listed order, inner direction in listed order
candidate_space.early_history: PULSE repeated N -> ZERO repeated N -> ZERO repeated R
candidate_space.late_history: ZERO repeated N -> PULSE repeated N -> ZERO repeated R
invariants: same pulse amplitude and count within pair
same integrated prescribed top forcing within pair
no sign reversal within either trajectory

qualification_logic.trajectory_admissibility: Both histories must complete transactionally with all committed intervals mass-complete and |mass residual|<=1e-12. A failed interval must preserve the latest committed origin.
qualification_logic.endpoint_access: W_profile and M1 are inspected only after both histories of a frozen candidate are fully admitted.
qualification_logic.selection: Select the first fully admitted candidate in frozen order satisfying both unchanged H2 endpoint criteria.
qualification_logic.no_match: If none satisfies both criteria, close NO_MATCH and do not open E_c.

probe.support_rule: Selected histories and probes must replay exactly, remain mass-complete and read-only, and abs(delta E_c)>1e-18.

controls: no change to retry budget, temporal budget, solver tolerances or mass gate
no E_c access before endpoint selection
no production interface ledger publication during state preparation
